Let me now also decide qing field key handling — I'll write code robust to both:
```rust
Treasury::Field(name) => {
// qing 字段面国库：字段值可能按区（华北…）或按「全国」聚合——
// 支取/入账统一落在值最大的键上（国库集中语义），账面留痕
}
```
Implementation: find entry with max value; take=min(val, want) subtract; give adds to max entry (or 全国 if exists).
```rust
fn field_treasury_top(w: &World, name: &str) -> Option<String> {
let f = w.material.fields.get(name)?;
f.values.iter().max_by(|a, b| a.1.partial_cmp(b.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal))
.filter(|(_, v)| **v > 0.0)
.map(|(k, _)| k.clone())
}
```
Hmm — but for give when all zero: fall back to "全国" if the map is empty or all zero? If all zero and map has keys, add to first key. If empty map, create "全国".
```rust
fn treasury_take(w: &mut World, want: f64) -> f64 {
match treasury_of(w) {
Treasury::Cell(cell) => w.material.consume_from_cell(&cell, "库银", want),
Treasury::Field(name) => {
let top = field_treasury_top(w, &name);
let mut take = 0.0;
if let Some(key) = top {
let cur = w.material.fields.get(&name).and_then(|f| f.values.get(&key)).copied().unwrap_or(0.0);
take = cur.min(want);
if take > 0.0 {
if let Some(v) = w.material.fields.get_mut(&name).and_then(|f| f.values.get_mut(&key)) {
*v -= take;
}
}
}
